about: A tool that keeps your config files in one place and installs them on every machine.

prs.title: Uninstall no longer deletes your saved dotfiles
prs.broken: Uninstalling a folder that was installed as a link followed the link and deleted the original files kept in the dotfiles repo.
prs.changed: A link is now removed as a link, and the files it points to are left alone.
prs.matters: People's saved config files are safe when they uninstall.
